blocks.content: To count the number of capital letters in a string, check if a character is uppercase, and if it is we will count it.
Let's see a detailed overview of how to solve this problem.

items: Convert the string into a character array using the CharArray() method. This will make it easier to work with the individual characters of the string.
Initialize a counter variable named count to 0. This will keep count of the number of capital letters.
Use a for loop to loop through the character array. Inside the loop, use the isUpperCase() method to check if the character is in uppercase. If true, increase count by 1.
